Then $\mathrm{ELBO}(p, p(\cdot \mid x)) = \log p(x)$, where $\mathrm{ELBO}(p, q) = \sum_{z} q(z) (\log p(z) - \log q(z))$.

The evidence lower bound of $q$ is $\mathrm{ELBO}(p, q) = \sum_{z \in Z} q(z) \bigl(\log p(z) - \log q(z)\bigr)$.

Then the evidence lower bound of expectation-maximization, $\sum_{n=1}^N \sum_{z \in Z} q_n(z) \bigl(\log p_\theta(x_n, z) - \log q_n(z)\bigr)$, equals…

nodes.summary: Let $Z$ be a finite set and let $p : Z \to \mathbb{R}$ give the joint values $p(z) = p(x, z)$ of a fixed observation $x$ with each latent value $z \in Z$ (an unnormalized posterior). The evidence is $p(x) = \sum_{z \in Z} p(z)$.
nodes.title: Evidence of an unnormalized posterior

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets and let $p : A \times B \to \mathbb{R}$ and $q_2 : B \to \mathbb{R}$. For $a \in A$, the expected log-joint of $a$ under $q_2$ is $\mathbb{E}_{q_2}[\log p(a, \cdot)] = \sum_{b \in B} q_2(b) \log p(a, b)$.
nodes.title: Expected log-joint

nodes.summary: Let $Z$ be a finite set, let $q$ be a probability distribution on $Z$, and let $r : Z \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy $r(z) > 0$ for every $z \in Z$ and $\sum_{z \in Z} r(z) = 1$. Then $\mathrm{KL}(q \,\|\, r) = \sum_{z \in Z} q(z) \bigl(\log q(z) - \log r(z)\bigr) \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Gibbs' inequality

nodes.summary: Let $Z$ be a nonempty finite set, let $p : Z \to \mathbb{R}$ satisfy $p(z) > 0$ for every $z \in Z$, and let $q$ be a probability distribution on $Z$. Let $\pi(z) = p(z) / \sum_{z' \in Z} p(z')$ be the posterior of $p$. Then $\mathrm{KL}(q \,\|\, \pi) = \sum_{z \in Z} q(z) \bigl(\log q(z) - \log \pi(z)\bigr) \ge 0$.
nodes.title: The KL divergence to the posterior is nonnegative

nodes.summary: Let $Z$ be a finite set and let $q, r : Z \to \mathbb{R}$. The Kullback–Leibler formula of $q$ against $r$ is $\mathrm{KL}(q \,\|\, r) = \sum_{z \in Z} q(z) \bigl(\log q(z) - \log r(z)\bigr)$; terms with $q(z) = 0$ vanish.
nodes.title: Finite Kullback–Leibler formula

nodes.summary: Let $Z$ be a finite set and let $p : Z \to \mathbb{R}$ give the joint values $p(z) = p(x, z)$ of a fixed observation $x$ with each latent value $z \in Z$. The posterior of $z$ is $p(z \mid x) = p(z) / p(x)$, where $p(x) = \sum_{z' \in Z} p(z')$ is the evidence (the quotient is read as $0$ when $p(x) = 0$).
nodes.title: Posterior of an unnormalized joint

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets and let $q_1 : A \to \mathbb{R}$ and $q_2 : B \to \mathbb{R}$. Their mean-field (product) distribution is the function on $A \times B$ given by $q(a, b) = q_1(a) \, q_2(b)$.
nodes.title: Mean-field product distribution

nodes.summary: Let $A$ and $B$ be finite sets and let $p : A \times B \to \mathbb{R}$. The swapped joint of $p$ is the function on $B \times A$ given by $(b, a) \mapsto p(a, b)$.
nodes.title: Swapped joint

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
